description: A horizontal slicer bar for Power BI — several slicers in one compact strip, as chips or dropdown panels, for dashboards where filter real estate is at a premium. Codex Slicer Bar replaces a stack of individual slicers with a single horizontal row that doubles as the report header. Each section carries its own label and values; a section shows its values inline as chips or collapses into a dropdown panel, and the bar keeps a running count of everything currently filtering. IDEAL FOR Dashboards with several slicers competing for header space Report header rows that need to filter as well as title the page Mobile and tablet layouts where vertical space is precious Pages where users select across many dimensions — region, period, status KEY FEATURES Chips or dropdown panel per section, or Auto — a section switches to a dropdown once it exceeds the visible-chip limit Single or multi selection, set for the whole bar or overridden per section Click a selected chip to clear it; Clear all resets one section or the whole bar Live count of active filters, per section and across the bar Dropdown panels fan right, left, up or down — Auto flips them at the viewport edge Configurable maximum visible chips and sections, with a "+N more" overflow Optional pre-selected default value per section Sort order field controls the order sections and chips appear in Applies…
